derivation: from the same as H1828 (דֹּמֶן); dunghill;

occurrences.text: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.
